title: This Lizard Glides 60 Metres Through the Air on Rib Wings

scenes.text: This lizard glides through the air on wings made of ribs.
It is the Draco, or flying dragon lizard, from Southeast Asia.
Its ribs are extra long and hold flaps of skin that spread like wings.
From a tree about ten metres up, it can glide as far as sixty metres.
That is sixty metres of glide for only ten metres of drop.
And the whole animal is about the length of a pencil.

description:
The Draco, or flying dragon lizard, glides up to 60 metres on flaps of skin held out by extra-long ribs, losing only about 10 metres of height.
The whole animal is only about 20 centimetres long, including its tail.
What would you do with wings? Comment below.
